title: AI-Powered Analysis with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: The Challenge: Data Analysis Takes Time

features.name: Copilot AI-Powered Analysis
features.description: Copilot simplifies data analysis by transforming raw data into insightful summaries using next-generation AI. Users can describe what they need and Copilot creates totals, pivots, and filters to help find information.

features.name: Trend and Outlier Exploration
features.description: Users can easily explore trends and outliers within Business Central without leaving the application, with support for most Business Central data including customizations.
caveats: available for most Business Central data, including customizations

quotes.text: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central has powerful built-in capabilities to analyze and report on data, but finding the insights you need takes time.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the problem statement that motivates the Copilot solution.

quotes.text: Copilot simplifies analysis by transforming raw data into insightful summaries using next-generation AI.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core value proposition and technology approach of Copilot for analysis.

quotes.text: Now, you can easily explore trends and outliers without ever leaving Business Central. And it's available for most Business Central data, even your customizations.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the broad availability and scope of the Copilot analysis feature.

quotes.text: Make data-driven decisions that propel your business forward with Copilot in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: States the intended business outcome and benefit of using Copilot for analysis.
